column3: “God” is supplied as the object of serving; day and night reverse the order.
“All I could” replaces doing many opposing things.
“Condemned to death” replaces being put to death.
“Had them punished” presents the punishment indirectly; “tried” makes the compulsion explicitly attempted.
“What I will show you” replaces what He will appear to Paul in.
“Your own” is supplied to qualify the people.
The two clauses introduced by “whether” are presented as statements; “our” is added to the people.
BSB’s “said” matches the Textus Receptus (ἔφη); the critical text has no verb of speaking.
“Replied” supplies a speech verb; the little and much are explicitly interpreted as time.
